# 0 Set up environment
```{r}
# Clean environment
rm( list = ls() )

# load libraries
library(qqman)
library(circlize)
library(VennDiagram)
library(stringr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggplot2)

# Prepare Plotting functions 
manhattan_plot <- function(data, data_full, type, ann=T) {
  # Compute significance threshold
  threshold <- -log10(0.05 / nrow(data_full))
  
  # Subset for significant hits (above threshold and not NA in label)
  ann_sub <- data[ -log10(data$lrt.pvalue) > threshold & !is.na(data[["gene"]]), ]
  
  # Calculate expanded y limits
   y_max <- max(-log10(data$lrt.pvalue), na.rm = TRUE)
   y_lim <- c(0, max(y_max,threshold) * 1.10)
  
  plot <- ggplot(data, aes(x=POS, y=-log10(lrt.pvalue))) +
    geom_point(aes(color=OR_pos), alpha=0.8, size=1.3) +
    scale_color_manual(values= c("skyblue", "orange")) +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = y_lim) +
    theme_bw()+
    theme(
      legend.title = element_blank(), 
      panel.border = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Genomic Position (Start)",
      y = expression(-log[10](italic(p))),
      title = paste0(type, " Manhattan Plot with Significant Hits Annotated")
    ) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = threshold, color="red", lty="dashed") 
  
  if(ann==F){
   plot
  }else{
    plot +
    geom_label_repel(
      data = ann_sub,
      aes(label = .data[["gene"]]),
      size = 2,
      min.segment.length = 0.5,
      show.legend = FALSE,
      na.rm = TRUE, 
      max.overlaps = Inf)
  }
}

QQ_plot <- function(data, type){
  df <- data.frame(expected= (-log10(ppoints(length(data |> pull(lrt.pvalue))))), 
                             observed=(-log10(sort(data |> pull(lrt.pvalue))))) 
  df |>
    ggplot(aes(x = expected, y = observed)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color="red", lty="dashed")  +      
  labs(
    x = "-log10(Expected P)",
    y = "-log10(Observed P)",
    title = paste0(type," QQ plot")
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
  xlim(0, 10) +
  ylim(0, 10)
}

```

# 1. Main Analysis

```{r}
# Load Missingness proportion 
Missingness_Prop <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/Missingness_Prop.txt")
Core_region_POS <- Missingness_Prop |> filter(V2<0.05) |> pull(V1)

SNPGWAS_data_Fasttree_LMM <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/SNPGWAS_Fasttree_LMM.txt", sep = "\t", header=T)|>
  filter(af>=0.05, af <0.95)|> 
  mutate(POS=as.integer(str_split(as.character(variant), "_", simplify = T)[,2]), 
         OR = exp(beta),

  filter(POS %in% Core_region_POS)
```

# 1.2. DB-GWAS (Fastree DP LMM, Panaroo, Binary)
```{r}
# Load GWAS results
DBGWAS_FastTree <- read.table("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/DBGWAS_Fasttree_LMM.txt", sep = "\t", header=T) |>
  filter(af >=0.05, af <0.95)

# Load Annotations
DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations <- read.delim("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/DBGWAS_Fasttree_LMM_annotation.txt", sep = "\t", header=F) 
colnames(DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations) <- colnames(DBGWAS_FastTree)
DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations <- DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations |> 
  filter(af >=0.05, af <0.95)|>
  mutate(core_accessory = ifelse(str_extract(notes, "^[^:]+")=="AP018935.1", "ref", "accessory"),
         coord_range = str_extract(notes, "(?<=:)[0-9]+-[0-9]+"), 
         start= str_split(coord_range, "-", simplify = T)[,1], 
         end= str_split(coord_range, "-", simplify = T)[,2],
         POS = as.integer(str_extract(coord_range, "^[0-9]+")),
         OR = exp(beta), 
         OR_pos =ifelse(OR<1, "OR<1", "OR>1"))  |>
  separate(
    notes, 
    into = c("contig_position", "upstream", "gene", "downstream"), 
    sep = ";", 
    remove = FALSE, 
    fill = "right"
  )

# Manhattan Plot
DBGWAS_FastTree_manplot <- manhattan_plot(DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations |> filter(core_accessory=="ref"), DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations, "DBGWAS")
DBGWAS_FastTree_manplot
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/DBGWAS_manplot.png", plot = DBGWAS_FastTree_manplot, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in")

DBGWAS_FastTree_manplot_core <- manhattan_plot(DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations |> filter(core_accessory=="ref") |> filter(POS %in% Core_region_POS), DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations, "DBGWAS")
DBGWAS_FastTree_manplot_core
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/DBGWAS_manplot_core.png", plot = DBGWAS_FastTree_manplot_core, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in")


# Results table 
DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations_sig <- DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations |> 
  filter(lrt.pvalue < 0.05 /nrow(DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations))  
DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations_sig_acc <- DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations_sig |> 
  filter(core_accessory =="accessory")   |> 
  arrange(POS)
DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations_sig_ref <- DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations_sig |> 
  filter(core_accessory =="ref")   |> 
  arrange(POS)
DBGWAS_final <- rbind(DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations_sig_acc, DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations_sig_ref)
DBGWAS_final

DBGWAS_final |>
  mutate(core_accessory = factor(core_accessory, levels= c("core", "accessory")))|>
  arrange(core_accessory, as.numeric(start))|>
  mutate(
    OR = exp(beta),
    OR_lower = exp(beta - 1.96 * beta.std.err),
    OR_upper = exp(beta + 1.96 * beta.std.err),
    OR_CI = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f; %.2f)", OR, OR_lower, OR_upper),
    P_value = formatC(lrt.pvalue, format = "e", digits = 2)
  ) |>
  mutate(Number= 1:nrow(DBGWAS_final))|> 
  dplyr::select(Number, variant, core_accessory, coord_range, af, OR_CI, P_value, gene) 


# QQ plot 
DBGWAS_FastTree_qqplot <- QQ_plot(DBGWAS_FastTree_annotations, "DBGWAS")
DBGWAS_FastTree_qqplot
ggsave("~/GitHub/GBS-GWAS-CDC-EOD-LOD/Analysis/Pyseer Results/Nextflow_pipeline_EOD_LOD_VLOD_CDC_NL_TW/DBGWAS_QQplot.png", plot = DBGWAS_FastTree_qqplot, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300, units = "in", bg = "white")

```
